tracks.title: Table Four, Table Six
tracks.subject: On a blind date set up by his sister, Colin sits at table four and Jan at table six of a Liverpool tea room, each secretly brought a best friend to spy from the next table, and it is the two spies who start talking.
tracks.caption: Merseybeat, early-1960s British beat group sound. Chiming twelve-string Rickenbacker jangle on open chords, driving melodic bass guitar, crisp snare-and-tom backbeat with ride cymbal, handclaps on the choruses, bright electric rhythm guitar. Dry 1963 tape sound with slight saturation, punchy mono-leaning mix. Male lead tenor with a second male voice in close two-part harmony, cheeky and bright delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, A major. Cheeky, bright, jangly. No rap, no autotune, no synthesizers, no electronic drums, no distorted modern guitars, no vocal effects.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twelve-string jangle, bass, snare count-in]

[Verse 1]
Our Sue said wear the blue cravat
Sit at table four, don't fuss
She's at table six, you'll see
Reading menus upside down

[Pre-Chorus]
I brought my mate, she brought hers too
Each behind a pot of tea

[Chorus]
Oh, the spies are talking, spies are talking
While the two of us just stare
Oh, the spies are talking, spies are talking
Over scones at table five

[Verse 2]
Dave is passing her friend the jam
Pat is laughing at his jokes
We're both pretending not to look
Two cold cups and nothing said

[Pre-Chorus]
He brought a mate, she brought one too
Now the mates are leaving us

[Chorus]
Oh, the spies are laughing, spies are laughing
And we sit here with the bill
Oh, the spies are walking, spies are walking
Out the door, arm in arm

[Bridge - drums and clap only]
Shall we push the tables together

[Chorus]
Oh, the spies are married, spies are married
By the summer, so they say
Oh, we're still talking, still talking
Over scones at table five

[Outro - jangle and bass, ring-out ending]
Table four, table six

tracks.title: The Penny Blue
tracks.subject: A woman goes to the Saturday stamp fair in a church hall to buy one gift, keeps returning to the same dealer's table asking for the penny blue, and is really watching his careful tweezers.
tracks.caption: Cool-jazz waltz in 3/4, West Coast vocal jazz trio-plus-horn sound. Brushed snare in a slow waltz pattern, upright bass walking in three, muted flugelhorn answering the vocal phrases, nylon-string guitar comping soft seventh chords, sparse piano fills. Intimate small-room jazz-club mix, natural room ambience, warm analogue tone. Female alto, warm and steady, gentle phrasing with clear diction. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, F major. Tender, warm, unhurried. No rap, no autotune, no drum machine, no distorted guitar, no synthesizer, no swing-big-band brass section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - brushes, upright bass, muted flugelhorn]

[Verse 1]
Saturday in the church hall
Trestle tables, folding chairs
I came to buy one stamp, that's all
A gift for my brother, nothing more

[Pre-Chorus]
You lift it with your tweezers
Like it might say something back

[Chorus]
Show me the penny blue again
Slowly, slowly, hold it in the light
I don't need the penny blue
I just need to watch your hands

[Verse 2]
Third week now I'm at your table
You know my name, I know your glass
You measure every little tooth
I count the hours till next Saturday

[Pre-Chorus]
You lift it with your tweezers
Like it might say something back

[Chorus]
Show me the penny blue once more
Pretend there's a flaw along the edge
I don't need the penny blue
I just need to watch your hands

[Bridge - guitar and bass only]
Seventeen pounds, I leave a twenty

[Chorus]
Keep the penny blue, my love
Keep it safe inside the album
All I wanted was the Saturday
And the way you hold a small thing

[Outro - flugelhorn, brushes fade]
Show me the penny blue

tracks.title: Floor Thirty-One
tracks.subject: A Lagos high-rise window cleaner on a rope seat watches a man on floor thirty-one rehearse his resignation speech to the glass every Tuesday, nods him on, and the man finally quits and waves the cleaner in for coffee.
tracks.caption: Ghanaian-style highlife with a Lagos flavour. Two interlocking clean electric guitars in bright highlife picking, bubbling melodic bass, trumpet and alto sax playing short riffs between lines, congas with clave and shaker, relaxed rolling groove. Live-band room sound, bright horns, warm vintage mix. Male baritone lead with a small call-and-response group answering, cheerful and warm. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Playful, warm, rolling. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth bass, no distorted guitar, no trap hi-hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - interlocking guitars, congas, horn riff]

[Verse 1]
I hang outside on a yellow rope
Thirty floors above Victoria Island
Squeegee in my hand, bucket on my knee
Nobody looks at the man on the glass

[Pre-Chorus]
But floor thirty-one, on Tuesday morning
A man in a tie is talking to me

[Chorus]
Say it, oga, say it to the window
I will clean it clear, I will not tell
Floor thirty-one, say it to the window
Tell your boss goodbye, I'm right here

[Verse 2]
Three Tuesdays he practised with a shaking hand
Dear sir, I resign, thank you for the years
I wipe the corner slowly, I nod my head
He bows to the glass like a man on stage

[Pre-Chorus]
Then a Tuesday came and he did not stop
He walked to the office with his box

[Chorus]
He said it, oga, he said it to the boss
I watched him leave through the glass
Floor thirty-one, he's standing on the street
Waving up at me with two cups of coffee

[Bridge - guitars and congas only]
Come down, the rope can wait an hour

[Chorus]
Say it, oga, say it to the window
Now the window says it back to you
Floor thirty-one, I'm swinging down to coffee
Squeegee in my belt and the city below

[Outro - horns and guitars, groove fades]
Floor thirty-one

tracks.title: Six Ten at the Swing Bridge
tracks.subject: A swing-bridge keeper on a small river turns the span open at 6:10 every morning for one coal barge, knows its pilot only by her two horn blasts and a lamp, and today leaves the bridge open and walks down to the quay with two cups of tea.
tracks.caption: Motorik krautrock-pop, 1970s German motorik beat with a warm melodic top line. Relentless motorik 4/4 drum beat with steady hi-hat and snare on two and four, pulsing eighth-note bass guitar, chiming clean guitar with light delay, analogue string-synth pad, simple repeating organ line. Spacious dry analogue studio mix, slight tape flutter, steady forward drive. Male tenor, calm and even, plain delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, D minor. Hypnotic, steady, quietly warm. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitars, no heavy modern bass drops, no vocal effects.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - motorik drums, pulsing bass, chiming guitar]

[Verse 1]
Ten past six, I turn the key
The iron span begins to swing
A coal barge rounds the river bend
Two horn blasts and the water sings

[Pre-Chorus]
I have never heard her name
I know her lamp, I know her wave

[Chorus]
Open the bridge, let the morning through
Two long blasts, I know it's you
Every day I turn it round
Open the bridge, let the morning through

[Verse 2]
Four years of tea gone cold up here
I log the hour, I log the weight
The barge slides under, slow and low
She tips her cap, she never waits

[Pre-Chorus]
I have never heard her name
Today I walk down there

[Chorus]
Open the bridge, let the morning through
Two long blasts, I know it's you
I leave the span out wide and stay
Open the bridge, let the morning through

[Bridge - bass and drums only]
Two cups of tea, one set of stairs

[Chorus]
Open the bridge, let the morning through
Two long blasts, and I walk down to you
The river holds the bridge apart
Open the bridge, let the morning through

[Outro - organ, drums drive on]
Ten past six, ten past six

tracks.title: Greensleeves on Every Street
tracks.subject: An ice-cream van driver whose chime box is jammed on four bars of one tune sells out on every estate because children chase it, and decides to build his whole route around it.
tracks.caption: Colombian cumbia-pop in a bouncing dance-band style. Bright accordion carrying the melody, guacharaca scraper on the offbeats, tumbadora and alegre drums in the cumbia pattern, bouncing electric bass on the one-and-three, tambora, short bright brass stabs. Live Latin dance-band mix, bright accordion, warm percussion, polished. Male tenor lead with party shouts from a small group, cheerful and energetic. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, C major. Upbeat, funny, danceable. tracks.title: Empat Puluh Persen
tracks.subject: a Medan radio weather forecaster who every morning is phoned by listeners asking which forty percent of the city will get the rain, until he starts answering street by street
tracks.caption: Melayu Deli joget, lively northern Sumatran Malay dance style. Accordion playing a bouncing melody with grace-note turns, two violins doubling in octaves, gendang ronggeng hand drum keeping the joget pulse, tambourine on the offbeat, plucked acoustic bass. Live room recording, warm tape, dry percussion. Male vocal, mid register, bright and cheerful, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, G major. Playful, bouncing mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no pop synths, no rap, no distorted guitar, no dangdut koplo drum pattern.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and gendang ronggeng]

[Verse 1]
Jam enam pagi aku siaran di radio
Telepon berbunyi, Bang, hari ini gimana
Aku bilang hujan empat puluh persen
Ibu di ujung sana tanya, persen yang mana

[Pre-Chorus]
Jemuran Ibu di Jalan Sei Kera
Jemuran Ibu di Jalan Sei Kera

[Chorus]
Empat puluh persen, tolong jangan salah paham
Bukan separuh kota, bukan sepanjang jalan
Empat puluh persen, bawa payung kalau ragu
Aku cuma baca awan, bukan baca hatimu

[Verse 2]
Tukang becak menelepon tanya soal Medan Johor
Di peta radar awannya malas gerak
Kujawab satu-satu, jalan demi jalan
Sei Kera kering dulu, Johor nanti sore

[Chorus]
Empat puluh persen, tolong jangan salah paham
Bukan separuh kota, bukan sepanjang jalan
Empat puluh persen, bawa payung kalau ragu
Aku cuma baca awan, bukan baca hatimu

[Verse 3]
Besok ada telepon dari gadis di Kampung Baru
Katanya jemuran Ibu cuma alasan
Dia tanya apa aku sendiri bawa payung
Kujawab nanti sore, aku datang jemput

[Chorus]
Seratus persen, hari ini aku mau ketemu
Bukan separuh hati, bukan sepanjang jalan
Seratus persen, nggak usah bawa payung
Awan boleh lewat, kamu tetap kutunggu

[Outro - accordion and violin]

tracks.title: Sepatu Sekolah Ukuran Besar
tracks.subject: a shoe cobbler at a Kupang market who stitches a boy's school shoes with fishing line each term and secretly keeps the next size up on the shelf for him
tracks.caption: Rote sasando folk-pop, East Nusa Tenggara village feel. Sasando with shimmering rolling plucked arpeggios, fingerpicked nylon acoustic guitar, soft round bass, small shaker on the beat. Close dry wooden-room recording with a short natural reverb. Female vocal, warm mid register, gentle and unhurried, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 78 BPM, D major. Gentle, warm mood. No drum kit, no electronic beats, no autotune, no strings pad, no rap, no pop-ballad piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sasando arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
Pak Yohan duduk di pasar Oebobo
Jarum besar, benang dari pancing
Sepatu Melki sobek lagi di ujung
Dijahit rapat, tahan satu semester

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiap bulan kakinya makin panjang
Tiap bulan Pak Yohan tambah senyum

[Chorus]
Sepatu sekolah ukuran besar
Disimpan di rak paling atas
Belum ada yang tanya, belum ada yang beli
Menunggu kaki yang sedang tumbuh

[Verse 2]
Melki datang bawa sepatu berdebu
Uangnya cuma tiga ribu di saku
Pak Yohan bilang, cukup, taruh saja
Besok kamu bantu aku menyapu

[Chorus]
Sepatu sekolah ukuran besar
Disimpan di rak paling atas
Hari ini Melki pakai, pas di tumitnya
Pak Yohan pura-pura sibuk menjahit

[Bridge - sasando alone]
Tali pancing masih ada di meja
Satu gulung lagi untuk tahun depan

[Chorus]
Sepatu sekolah ukuran besar
Sudah turun dari rak paling atas
Melki berjalan pulang tanpa menoleh
Pak Yohan tersenyum, pasar mulai sepi

[Outro - sasando and guitar]

[Intro - claves and nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
Aku Darto, lima puluh delapan tahun
Kakiku kaku, kata istriku dulu
Diam-diam daftar kursus sepuluh kali
Tiap Selasa pamit beli paku

Guru dansa menghitung keras-keras
Aku menghitung dalam hati

Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha

Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha

Lastri, tunggu aku di lantai
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Tiga puluh tahun, baru sekarang

Malam ini musik main di aula

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Lastri, ikut aku di lantai

tracks.title: Telapak Tanganku Kosong
tracks.subject: a palm reader at a Yogyakarta night fair who tells every customer a bright future, and has never dared to read his own palm
tracks.caption: Indonesian 1970s psychedelic soul-pop, Jakarta studio band style. Wah-wah electric guitar chopping on the offbeat, Hammond organ with Leslie swirl, round funky bass line, tight drum kit with congas, no brass section. Vintage analog tape, slight phaser on guitar. Male vocal, mid-high register, confident and teasing, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, E minor. Cheeky, swaggering mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no modern synths, no rap, no heavy distortion, no dangdut koplo drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - wah guitar and organ]

[Verse 1]
Pasar malam Yogya, lampu kuning menggantung
Aku duduk di tikar dengan kartu dan kaca
Gadis pertama datang, kubaca garis hatinya
Bakal ketemu orang baik, kataku

[Pre-Chorus]
Bapak-bapak datang, kubilang rezeki naik
Anak sekolah datang, kubilang nilai bagus

[Chorus]
Telapak tanganku kosong, nggak berani kubaca
Semua orang kuramal, tinggal aku sendiri
Telapak tanganku kosong, siapa mau baca
Garisnya samar, tapi kamu duduk di situ

[Verse 2]
Kamu datang bawa tiket parkir di saku
Tanganmu kecil, garisnya lurus ke arahku
Aku buka mulut, tiba-tiba lupa semua
Kartu jatuh, kaca retak, kamu tertawa

[Chorus]
Telapak tanganku kosong, nggak berani kubaca
Semua orang kuramal, tinggal aku sendiri
Telapak tanganmu hangat, kuletakkan di sini
Dua garis bertemu, lupa ramalan

[Verse 3]
Tutup tikar jam sebelas, tukang bakso lewat
Kamu tunggu di pagar dengan dua mangkuk
Kubaca garis tanganmu, pelan satu-satu
Hari ini aku jujur, kita makan dulu

[Chorus]
Telapak tanganku kosong, sekarang ada kamu
Semua orang kuramal, kamu cukup kupegang
Telapak tanganku penuh, nggak perlu kubaca
Garisnya baru mulai, kita lihat besok

[Outro - wah guitar fade]

tracks.title: Jendela Seberang
tracks.subject: a tower crane operator in Jakarta who sits forty metres up every morning and sees a woman across the street water her windowsill herbs, and finally lowers his hook with a note
tracks.caption: Indonesian progressive rock, 1970s-influenced studio sound. Mellotron string and flute tones, clean electric guitar arpeggios swelling into a lead guitar line, melodic bass guitar, drum kit with changing time feel, Rhodes piano under the verses. Wide stereo room, analog warmth. Male vocal, clear tenor, controlled and earnest, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, E minor. Reflective, building mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no rap, no EDM synths, no growled vocals.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - mellotron and clean guitar]

[Verse 1]
Jam enam aku naik tangga besi
Empat puluh meter dari jalan Sudirman
Kabin kecilku sepi, kopiku pun dingin
Jendela seberang buka, ada yang menyiram

[Pre-Chorus]
Pot kecil di ambang, daun basilnya naik
Dia menyiram pelan, aku menunggu

[Chorus]
Jendela seberang, tiap pagi kulihat
Tanganmu menyiram, tanganku menunggu
Jendela seberang, aku tak tahu namamu
Hanya tahu basilmu tumbuh paling tinggi

[Verse 2]
Kubawa beton ke lantai tiga puluh
Kubawa besi ke lantai tiga puluh lima
Tiap kali kait lewat jendelamu
Kutahan napas, kau tak pernah menoleh

[Chorus]
Jendela seberang, tiap pagi kulihat
Tanganmu menyiram, tanganku menunggu
Jendela seberang, ini namaku, Arya
Kabinku di atas sana, lambaikan satu daun

[Bridge - guitar solo and mellotron]

[Verse 3]
Pagi berikutnya jendela terbuka lebar
Ada kertas putih ditempel di kaca
Tulisannya kecil, kubaca dengan teropong
Namaku Sari, basilnya buat kamu

[Chorus]
Jendela seberang, tiap pagi kulihat
Tanganmu melambai, tanganku membalas
Jendela seberang, sekarang ada namamu
Kuturun dari kabin, kubawa kopi yang hangat

[Outro - mellotron and guitar]

tracks.title: しっぽの人
tracks.subject: the rear-end operator inside a two-person wooden horse puppet at a children's theatre, who has seen only his front partner's back for twelve years and must learn to follow a new girl when the old partner is out
tracks.caption: Japanese Cuban guaracha, comic son dance-band style with a driving clave pulse. Tres guitar playing a bright repeated montuno figure, trumpet with short punchy stabs and a muted answer line, piano playing rolling octave montuno, upright bass on the tumbao, congas and bongos with claves on every bar. Dry warm 1950s dance-band studio sound, tape warmth. Young male lead with a group chorus answering each line, boyish bright mid register, clearly sung call-and-response. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, D minor. Mood: cheeky, comic and bouncy. No rap, no autotune, no synths, no electric guitar distortion, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tres guitar montuno, congas and claves]

[Verse 1]
馬の後ろ足が おれの場所
見えるのは 前の背中だけ
十二年 右に傾けば 右へ
合図はいらない 腰で聞く

[Pre-Chorus]
なのに今夜 前にいるのは
入ったばかりの 女の子

[Chorus]
ついていく ついていく
見えなくても くせでわかる
ついていく ついていく
ほら 馬が笑った

[Verse 2]
彼女は急に 左へ曲がる
おれは右で 馬が裂けそうだ
客席の子が 大笑いして
「馬が二つに わかれたよ」

[Chorus]
ついていく ついていく
見えなくても 息でわかる
ついていく ついていく
ほら 馬が歩く

[Bridge - trumpet solo over piano montuno]
幕が降りたあと 彼女が聞く
「うしろの人って どんな顔?」
おれは中から 尻尾を振った

[Chorus]
ついていく ついていく
今度は君の くせを覚える
ついていく ついていく
ほら 馬が走る

[Outro - tres and congas, band stops on the last hit]
尻尾がひとつ ぱたりと揺れた

tracks.title: 半音ずれたラ
tracks.subject: a piano tuner at an old couple's house whose upright has one A key slightly flat; the husband has played the same wrong note for forty years and the wife asks him to leave it exactly as it is
tracks.caption: Modern neoclassical chamber ballad led by felt-damped upright piano playing slow broken chords and single-note melodies, a solo cello holding long warm lines under the verses, a few sustained string quartet chords in the final chorus, very light brushed percussion only in the last chorus. Intimate chamber-room recording with natural hall reverb and close piano mics. Warm male baritone, full mid register, even and unhurried. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 68 BPM, C major. Mood: tender, still and warm. No rap, no autotune, no drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth pads, no pop drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo piano, then cello]

[Verse 1]
古いアップライトの 蓋をあける
ラの音だけ ほんの少し低い
「直しますね」と言ったとき
奥さんが 首を横にふった

[Pre-Chorus]
四十年 主人が弾いてきた
いつもそこで 少し笑うの

[Chorus]
半音ずれたラ そのままで
あの人の指が 毎晩さがす音
半音ずれたラ そのままで
ほかの音は ぼくが直した

[Verse 2]
ほかの八十七の鍵を
ひとつずつ ぼくは合わせた
台所から 湯気の音がして
ご主人が 帰ってきた

[Chorus]
半音ずれたラ そのままで
二人の足音に よく合う音
半音ずれたラ そのままで
聞こえるたびに 家に帰れる

[Bridge - cello alone]
道具をしまう ぼくの背中で
ご主人が 弾きはじめる
ラのところで 奥さんが歌った

[Chorus]
半音ずれたラ そのままで
今日からぼくも 好きになった
半音ずれたラ そのままで
蓋をそっと 閉じた

[Outro - piano, last note held]
ラの音がひとつ 低く響く

tracks.title: 壁を三回
tracks.subject: the woman who stokes the wood-fired boiler behind a small public bathhouse, who for twenty years has been answering a regular customer's knocks on the wall (two taps too hot, one tap just right) until tonight he knocks three times
tracks.caption: Nuevo tango in the style of Piazzolla chamber quintets. Bandoneon playing sharp staccato rhythm figures and slow melodic lines, solo violin with a rasping bow on the answers, upright piano with low block chords, double bass with a marcato walking bass, light dry percussion with wood-block accents. Dry close tango-orquesta chamber recording, slight room reverb on the strings. Female alto, dark and firm, dramatic but clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, D minor. Mood: dark, restrained and slowly warming. No rap, no autotune, no electronic beats, no electric guitar, no synths, no pop drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bandoneon and violin]

[Verse 1]
銭湯の裏で 薪をくべる
壁の向こうは 男湯の端
コンコンと二回 熱いのサイン
わたしは火を細めて 返事をする

[Pre-Chorus]
一回なら ちょうどいい湯加減
二十年 顔も知らないまま

[Chorus]
壁を三回 たたく音
熱くもない ぬるくもない
壁を三回 たたく音
知らない合図に 手がとまる

[Verse 2]
火かき棒を 持ったまま
壁に耳を あててみる
石けんの匂い 水の音
それから小さく 咳ばらい

[Chorus]
壁を三回 たたく音
熱くもない ぬるくもない
壁を三回 たたく音
返事に一回 たたいて返す

[Bridge - violin solo]
「ありがとう」の合図だよ
壁の向こうで 声がした
初めて聞いた 低い声

[Chorus]
壁を三回 たたく音
熱くもない ぬるくもない
壁を三回 たたく音
明日は薪を ひと束多く

[Outro - bandoneon, slowing]
コン コン コン

tracks.title: 빨간 펜 한 자루
tracks.subject: a freelance proofreader who walks the town at dusk and fixes typos on cloth shop banners with a red marker, until the bakery owner whose banner he corrected catches him and hands him a loaf
tracks.caption: Brazilian forró pé-de-serra, a Korean-language dance tune. Bright piano-style accordion carries the riff, zabumba bass drum and a ringing triangle keep the baião shuffle, nylon-string acoustic guitar strums offbeat chords. A bright male lead sings in a mid register with a playful, clearly sung melody and a small answering group on the chorus. Dry live-room recording, close percussion. 118 BPM, D major. Cheerful and mischievous. No electronic drums, no synth pads, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion riff over zabumba and triangle]

[Verse 1]
퇴근길에 빨간 펜을 꺼내
빵집 앞 현수막을 올려다봐
개업을 축하합니다 라는데
축하가 아니라 추하라고 썼네

[Pre-Chorus]
밤이 되면 사다리를 끌고 와
한 글자만 고치면 되는데

[Chorus]
빨간 펜 한 자루로
온 동네 글자를 바로잡아
틀린 건 못 참아 나는
맞춤법이 내 춤이야

[Verse 2]
사다리 위에서 불이 켜졌어
빵집 아저씨가 팔짱을 꼈어
너로구나 밤마다 그 사람
말 한마디 없이 빵을 쥐여줘

[Pre-Chorus]
고맙다는 말도 못 하고
받침 하나가 목에 걸렸어

[Chorus]
빨간 펜 한 자루로
온 동네 글자를 바로잡아
따뜻한 빵 한 봉지에
내일은 간판을 보러 갈게

[Bridge - accordion solo, triangle only]
쉿 쉿 조용히 해

[Chorus]
빨간 펜 한 자루로
온 동네 글자를 바로잡아
틀린 건 이제 안 보여도
빵 냄새는 안 틀리지

[Outro - accordion fades on the riff]
빨간 펜 빨간 펜 한 자루

tracks.title: 같은 이름을 부르면
tracks.subject: two strangers both named Kim Jiyoung stand up when a hospital waiting room calls the name, swap their prescription envelopes by mistake, and meet again to swap them back
tracks.caption: Hammond organ soul-jazz trio, Korean-language love song. Hammond B3 with slow Leslie swirl plays sustained chords and a warm bass-pedal line, brushed snare and ride cymbal keep a loose swing, upright bass walks quarter notes, a clean hollow-body guitar adds sparse octave fills. A warm male lead sings in a low-mid register with relaxed, clearly sung phrasing. Analog tape warmth, small-room reverb. 92 BPM, F major. Warm and shy. No synth pads, no drum machine, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Hammond organ chords with brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
접수대 간호사가 불렀어요
김지영 님 김지영 님
둘이 같이 일어났어요
서로 보고 조금 웃었죠

[Pre-Chorus]
약 봉투가 바뀐 줄도 모르고
각자 버스에 올랐어요

[Chorus]
같은 이름을 부르면
두 사람이 돌아봐요
내 이름이 처음으로
조금 특별해 보였어요

[Verse 2]
집에 와서 봉투를 열었더니
처음 보는 알약이 있었죠
병원에 전화를 걸어서
그 사람 번호를 받았어요

[Pre-Chorus]
카페 앞에서 만나기로 했어요
봉투 두 개를 손에 들고

[Chorus]
같은 이름을 부르면
두 사람이 돌아봐요
바꿔 들고 인사하다가
차 한 잔을 같이 했어요

[Bridge - organ alone, bass enters]
흔한 이름이라 늘 싫었는데

[Chorus]
같은 이름을 부르면
한 사람만 돌아봐요
다음 주 목요일 오후에
내가 먼저 불러 볼게요

[Outro - organ swells and settles]
김지영 님 김지영 님

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clarinet theme with frame drum]

[Verse 1]
옥상 빨랫줄에 널어 놓은
수건 열 장 양말 여덟 짝
집게가 하나씩 모자라요
일요일마다 하나씩이요

바람 탓인가 싶었는데

집게 하나 어디 갔니

집게 둘 집게 둘

tracks.title: 분필로 그은 눈금
tracks.genre: Andean folk-pop with quena and charango
tracks.subject: a woman who walks a neighbourhood stream each morning and marks the water level on the concrete wall with chalk, until a small boy starts copying her marks beside hers
tracks.caption: Andean folk-pop in Korean, huayno-influenced. Quena flute carries the pentatonic melody, charango strums fast tremolo patterns, bombo legüero marks a steady heartbeat, nylon guitar plays arpeggios, soft zampoña doubles the end of phrases. A soft female lead sings in a mid register with a steady, clearly sung melody. Open-air room, natural reverb. 96 BPM, E minor. Calm and watchful. No synthesizer, no electric guitar, no drum kit, no autotune, no rap. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - quena melody over charango tremolo]

[Verse 1]
아침마다 하천 둑을 걸어요
콘크리트 벽에 분필을 들고
어제보다 손가락 두 마디
물이 내려갔는지 올라갔는지

[Pre-Chorus]
아무도 시킨 적 없는 일인데
나는 날마다 눈금을 그어요

[Chorus]
분필로 그은 눈금
물이 지나간 자리마다
하나 둘 셋 오늘도 적어요
비가 오면 다시 지워져도

[Verse 2]
어느 날 작은 남자아이가
내 눈금 옆에 줄을 그었어요
삐뚤빼뚤 자기 키만큼이나
높게 그려 놓고 웃더라고요

[Pre-Chorus]
그만하라고 말하려다
아이가 먼저 고개를 끄덕였어요

[Chorus]
분필로 그은 눈금
두 줄이 나란히 올라가요
하나 둘 셋 같이 세어요
물이 불어도 우린 괜찮아요

[Bridge - quena alone, bombo enters softly]
비 온 다음 날 벽이 젖으면

[Chorus]
분필로 그은 눈금
이제는 둘이서 그어요
하나 둘 셋 소리 내어 세어요
물은 낮아지고 해는 높아요

[Outro - quena and zampoña fade]

metas.lyrics:
[Intro - quena melody over charango tremolo]

[Verse 1]
아침마다 하천 둑을 걸어요
콘크리트 벽에 분필을 들고
어제보다 손가락 두 마디
물이 내려갔는지 올라갔는지

[Pre-Chorus]
아무도 시킨 적 없는 일인데
나는 날마다 눈금을 그어요

분필로 그은 눈금

어느 날 작은 남자아이가
내 눈금 옆에 줄을 그었어요

높게 그려 놓고 웃더라고요

그만하라고 말하려다

분필로 그은 눈금
두 줄이 나란히 올라가요
하나 둘 셋 같이 세어요
물이 불어도 우린 괜찮아요

[Bridge - quena alone, bombo enters softly]
비 온 다음 날 벽이 젖으면

[Chorus]
분필로 그은 눈금
이제는 둘이서 그어요
하나 둘 셋 소리 내어 세어요
물은 낮아지고 해는 높아요

[Outro - quena and zampoña fade]

tracks.title: Simpulan Terakhir
tracks.genre: Malay Neapolitan tarantella-pop (mandolin-and-accordion fast 6/8 folk dance)
tracks.subject: a children's-party magician who has pulled the same chain of silk scarves from his sleeve for twenty-five years, and tonight his wife-assistant finds a ring knotted in the last scarf, the ring he could not afford at their wedding
tracks.caption: Malay Neapolitan tarantella-pop, galloping 6/8 folk dance with a spinning accelerating feel. Mandolin tremolo playing the hook, accordion pumping chords, tambourine shaking on the pulse, nylon guitar strumming, upright bass on the downbeats. Dry live-room folk-ensemble sound, tambourine forward. Male baritone, warm mid register, bright conversational sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, A minor. Playful, giddy and tender mood. No electric guitar, no synths, no drum kit, no autotune, no pop-trap drift, no ragtime piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - mandolin tremolo, tambourine]
[Verse 1]
Dua puluh lima tahun aku tarik skarf
Merah, kuning, hijau, semuanya sama
Budak bertepuk, mak-mak angkat telefon
Isteri berdiri tepi, pegang topi
[Pre-Chorus]
Malam ni lain sikit, tangan aku sejuk
Ada simpulan di hujung skarf biru
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Ini bukan silap mata, sayang
Dua puluh lima tahun kau tunggu
Cincin ni baru aku mampu
[Verse 2]
Dulu kita kahwin tanpa cincin
Kau kata, "Nanti kau sulap sendiri"
Aku simpan lima ringgit tiap kali show
Dalam kotak topi, bawah kain baldu
[Pre-Chorus]
Budak-budak menjerit, "Makcik, tengok tangan!"
Jari kau menggeletar buka simpulan
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Ini bukan helah, ini betul
Dua puluh lima tahun kau sabar
Cincin ni sekarang kau pakai
[Bridge - accordion, mandolin]
Kotak gergaji pun diam menunggu
Merpati pun tak berani bunyi
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Satu tepukan paling kuat
Dua puluh lima tahun, kita berdua
Cincin ni muat, ta-da, muat
[Outro - mandolin, accordion, tambourine]

tracks.title: Tangan Kiri Bawah Meja
tracks.genre: Malay calypso (Caribbean steel-pan calypso with Malay comic storytelling)
tracks.subject: a left-handed man at his girlfriend's mother's first Sunday lunch, forcing himself to eat nasi with his right hand while his left hides under the table, until the mother hands him the sambal with her own left hand and winks
tracks.caption: Malay calypso, Trinidadian steel-pan calypso two-feel with a lilting off-beat swing. Steel pan carrying the melody and hook, nylon-string acoustic guitar strumming on the off-beat, upright bass in a walking root-fifth pattern, congas and shaker, flute answering the vocal. Dry sunny live-band sound. Male tenor, bright mid register, cheeky storytelling sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G major. Playful, cheeky mood. No electric guitar, no synth pads, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no reggae dub effects.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - steel pan, congas]
[Verse 1]
Hari Ahad aku datang rumah mak dia
Kemeja bergosok, buah tangan sebakul
Aku kidal dari kecil, makan guna kanan
Nasi jatuh atas riba, kuah menitik seluar
[Pre-Chorus]
Mak dia pandang, aku telan air liur
Ayam goreng bergoyang di hujung jari
[Chorus]
Tangan kiri bawah meja
Rahsia aku seorang
Tangan kanan kuis nasi
Makcik, jangan tengok, jangan tengok
[Verse 2]
Sambal belacan jauh di depan mak dia
Aku nak minta, tapi tangan mana satu
Tiba-tiba mangkuk datang, laju dari kiri
Mak dia hulur guna tangan kiri!
[Pre-Chorus]
Dia kenyit mata, aku hampir tersedak
Dia bisik, "Cikgu dulu ikat tangan aku"
[Chorus]
Dua tangan kiri bawah meja
Rahsia kami berdua
Tangan kanan kuis nasi
Makcik, hulur sambal lagi, hulur sambal
[Bridge - steel pan, flute]
Adik dia ketawa, ayah dia tak faham
Kami berdua makan sambil senyum
[Chorus]
Tangan kiri atas meja
Rahsia dah terbuka
Tangan kiri makan sendiri
Makcik, tambah nasi, tambah nasi
[Outro - steel pan]

tracks.title: Kad Kecil
tracks.genre: Malay gamelan Melayu pop ballad (Terengganu/Pahang court-gamelan colour)
tracks.subject: a florist who writes the card for tongue-tied men, and the shy regular who every Friday dictates a different card for one name, Aini, her own name, until he stops asking her to deliver it
tracks.caption: Malay gamelan Melayu pop ballad with Terengganu and Pahang court-gamelan colour, slow gentle cycle. Gamelan metallophones (saron and kenong) playing a slow interlocking melody with soft mallets, gambang wooden-bar xylophone playing flowing broken figures, soft rebab bowing long phrases that answer the vocal, light kendang drum keeping a gentle sparse pulse with soft gong ends. Warm close studio sound with soft room reverb, bronze ring left to decay. Female alto, warm low-mid register, clear intimate sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 76 BPM, G major. Tender, quietly hopeful mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no pop-ballad belting, no sitar or tabla.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gamelan metallophones, gambang]
[Verse 1]
Aku tulis kad untuk lelaki kelu
Setiap Jumaat dia datang, ambil satu jambak
Dia sebut ayatnya, perlahan, aku tulis
"Maaf aku lambat", "Hujan tadi aku ingat kau"
[Pre-Chorus]
Semua kad pakai nama yang sama
Aku tak tanya, aku cuma tulis
[Chorus]
Kad kecil, tulisan tangan aku
Kata-kata dia di bawah lampu kedai
Kad kecil, siapa yang akan baca
Aku bungkus bunga dengan pita biru
[Verse 2]
Minggu lepas dia diam lama di kaunter
Kenanga di tangan, dia tak mahu hantar
"Simpan saja," katanya, "Nanti aku ambil"
Dia tak pernah ambil, jambak tinggal di sini
[Pre-Chorus]
Aku susun dalam balang, atas rak kaca
Nama di hujung kad, aku tak tanya
[Chorus]
Kad kecil, tulisan tangan aku
Hari ni dia dikte ayat paling pendek
Kad kecil, aku berhenti menulis
Aku baca nama itu, nama aku
[Bridge - rebab, kendang]
Dia berdiri di pintu, topi di tangan

tracks.genre: Malay spaghetti-western cinematic ballad (Morricone-style desert-circus soundtrack)
tracks.subject: a circus knife-thrower's wife who stands against the wooden board every night as his target, the knife that lands half a finger from her ear tonight, and her dry verdict that he is getting better
tracks.caption: Malay spaghetti-western cinematic ballad in a slow marching two-beat. Twangy baritone electric guitar with spring reverb carrying the melody, muted trumpet answering, tremolo strings holding the tension, timpani and snare rim clicks marking the walk, acoustic guitar strum underneath. Wide dusty room reverb, cinematic stereo space. Male baritone, low register, steady dramatic sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, A minor. Dry, tense, then tender mood. No synth pads, no drum machine, no autotune, no whistling, no pop-trap drift, no choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - baritone guitar, trumpet]
[Verse 1]
Khemah besar di padang, matahari rendah
Dia berdiri di papan, kasut merah, pita kuning
Aku pegang pisau pertama, tangan basah
Dia kata, "Jangan pandang aku, pandang papan"
[Pre-Chorus]
Penonton diam, dram berguling perlahan
Enam bilah, enam kali aku tarik nafas
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Seluruh kampung tahan nafas
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku yang menggeletar, bukan kau
[Verse 2]
Dulu mata tertutup pun aku tepat
Sekarang cermin mata aku tertinggal di khemah
Dia tahu, dia tak cakap, dia berdiri sahaja
Aku nampak pita kuning, aku bidik situ
[Pre-Chorus]
Pisau terakhir kena kayu, dekat sangat
Sehelai rambut jatuh, penonton menjerit
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Dia senyum, dia buka mata
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku yang menggeletar, bukan kau
[Bridge - strings, timpani]
Dia turun papan, cabut pisau satu-satu
"Makin baik," katanya, "esok lagi"
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Esok aku pakai cermin mata
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku pun tak ke mana-mana
[Outro - guitar, trumpet]

tracks.title: Cadar Sarung
tracks.subject: a couple trying to put a fitted sheet on a bed on Saturday morning, fighting over which corner is which and finally meeting in the middle of the mattress
tracks.caption: Malay 1970s Afrobeat, long polyrhythmic groove with a tight horn section. Two clean interlocking electric guitars playing repeating figures, electric bass locked on a one-bar riff, tenor sax and trumpet stabbing and answering the vocal, congas and shekere layering the rhythm, drum kit on a driving open hi-hat. Dry live band sound, light tape saturation. Female alto, bright relaxed mid register, playful conversational sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, G minor. Upbeat, funny, affectionate mood. No synth lead, no drum machine, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guitars, congas, bass riff]
[Verse 1]
Pagi Sabtu, cadar baru dari bungkusan
Kau pegang hujung kiri, aku hujung kanan
Empat penjuru, empat pendapat, satu katil
Getah tak muat, kita tarik dari dua arah
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata, "Yang ini atas", aku kata, "Bawah"
Cadar sangkut pada dahi kita
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Satu penjuru lagi, sabar sikit
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita jumpa di tengah tilam
[Verse 2]
Kau lompat atas katil, aku lompat sama
Hujung merah naik, hujung biru turun
Bantal jatuh, kucing pun lari
Aku ketawa, kau ketawa, cadar melorot
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata, "Sudahlah, tidur atas lantai"
Aku kata, "Tak boleh, cadar tu hadiah"
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Penjuru ketiga masuk, hampir menang
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita jumpa di tengah tilam
[Bridge - horns, congas]
Tangan kau pegang tangan aku, bukan hujung cadar
Empat penjuru, dua orang sahaja
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Penjuru keempat, bunyi klik, kita menang
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita baring di tengah tilam
[Outro - horns, guitars, congas]

Dry vintage 1970s studio mix, bright guitar, plain close vocal. Male baritone, warm and slightly nasal with light vibrato, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, D major. Teasing, easygoing rooftop evening. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no EDM drop.

tracks.title: 鞋帶鬆去矣 Ê-tuà Sang Khì Ah
tracks.subject: A nine-year-old who already knows how to tie laces but keeps loosening them so the sixth-grade crossing guard with the yellow flag will kneel and re-tie them each morning, until she says she knew all along and just wanted a rest.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien tropicália, playful late-1960s Brazilian psychedelic pop groove. Fuzz electric guitar with a short cheeky riff; berimbau twanging on the off beat; nylon guitar strumming steady open chords; electric bass bouncing; congas and a farfisa organ colouring the hook. Warm analog studio mix, slightly fuzzy guitar, dry vocal. Male tenor, light boyish and bright, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, A major. Cheeky, sunny schoolboy mischief. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no heavy distortion, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
阿母講 鞋帶愛縛予好
我早就會曉 我袂講
校門口舉黃旗的姊姊
逐早起 蹲落來共我縛

[Pre-Chorus]
我偷偷仔 共鞋帶放鬆
姊姊的手 就來矣

[Chorus]
鬆矣鬆矣 鞋帶鬆去矣
姊姊 請你 蹲落來
蝴蝶結縛兩迴
我今仔日 閣袂曉

[Verse]
同學笑我 九歲猶袂曉
我講 這馬流行 鬆鬆仔
鞋帶拖地 拖過水溝蓋
黃旗仔搖搖 姊姊嘛笑

[Pre-Chorus]
有一早 姊姊無蹲落
伊共旗仔 插佇腰後

[Chorus]
鬆矣鬆矣 鞋帶鬆去矣
姊姊 請你 蹲落來
蝴蝶結縛三迴
我明仔載 閣袂曉

[Verse]
伊講 你早就會曉縛
我有看你 家己縛過
我面紅甲 耳仔燒
伊講 我嘛愛蹲咧歇

[Bridge]
這擺換我 蹲落來
共姊姊的鞋帶 縛一个結

[Chorus]
鬆矣鬆矣 鞋帶鬆去矣
姊姊 換我 蹲落來
蝴蝶結縛四迴
阮兩个 攏袂曉

[Chorus]
鬆矣鬆矣 鞋帶鬆去矣
姊姊 換我 蹲落來
蝴蝶結縛四迴
阮兩个 攏袂曉

[Outro]
鞋帶鬆去矣
鬆去矣 鬆去矣

tracks.title: 毋看鏡頭 M̄ Khuànn Kèng-thâu
tracks.subject: In a bridal-photo studio's second-floor set the groom looks at the bride instead of the lens in all forty shots; the photographer sighs, the make-up artist retouches again, and she decides to keep that look.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien fado, slow Lisbon tavern ballad. Portuguese guitarra playing bright ringing arpeggios and short answering phrases; classical guitar strumming a steady slow chord pulse; double bass holding long low notes; soft brushed snare barely marking the beat. Intimate small-room mix, natural reverb, plain close vocal. Female alto, dark warm chest voice with slow vibrato, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D minor. Tender, wry, quietly adoring. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no drum machine, no synth pads, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
婚紗店二樓 白色布幕
攝影師講 看遮 看遮
你的目睭 閣走去佗位
偏偏 攏看我這爿

[Pre-Chorus]
四十張相矣 全部是按呢
伊看的 毋是鏡頭

[Chorus]
毋看鏡頭 伊攏看我
看甲攝影師 笑出聲
這張相若洗出來
逐家就知 伊的心

[Verse]
禮服較重 領結歪一爿
伊的手心 全是汗
我共手巾 遞過去
伊閣看我 袂記得擦

[Pre-Chorus]
化妝師補粉 補第三擺
伊猶原 無看鏡頭

[Chorus]
毋看鏡頭 伊攏看我
看甲化妝師 嘛笑矣
這張相若洗出來
逐家就知 伊的心

[Verse]
第三套衫 規晝矣
便當食冷 無人想欲食
攝影師共鏡頭 放落
講 恁自然就好

[Bridge]
免閣喝矣 按呢就好
愛看就看 我袂閃

[Chorus]
毋看鏡頭 伊攏看我
看甲我嘛 面紅紅
這張相若洗出來
逐家就知 阮的心

[Outro]
毋看鏡頭 伊攏看我
這世人的 第一張相

tracks.title: 輪仔內底的戒指 Lián-á Lāi-té ê Kài-tsí
tracks.subject: A Pingtung roadside tyre-repair man finds a gold ring wedged in the tread of a scooter tyre and holds it up at the red light for every passing rider, until a delivery woman who lost it a week ago stops; she says she had already bought a new one but still wants this one.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Saharan desert blues, hypnotic Tuareg-style guitar groove. Electric guitar playing a looping pentatonic riff with dry, slightly gritty tone and hammer-ons; second guitar holding a steady droning bass figure; calabash and hand-drum percussion in a rolling shuffle; tindé-style skin drum on the offbeats; a small group answering the lead line in call-and-response. Dry live desert-band room sound, warm tape grit, no polish. Male baritone, warm and plain, clearly sung melody, one lead voice with a few answering voices. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, D minor. Wry, tender, roadside-patient. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no EDM drop, no brass section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
補胎仔店 佇路邊
外胎剝落來 攤佇遐
胎紋縫內 夾一箍物
金金仔 是一个戒指

[Pre-Chorus]
無名無姓 內面無字
我共伊款佇 螺絲箱

[Chorus]
是啥人的戒指 失落去
一路騎 一路揣
我徛佇路邊 舉懸懸
一台一台 看你欲停無

[Verse]
紅燈仔前 偌濟台機車
我共戒指 舉予人看
有人搖頭 有人笑
有人催油 騎去矣

[Pre-Chorus]
黃昏彼个 送貨的查某
車停落來 手指摸一下

[Chorus]
是我的 失落的
一禮拜 一路揣
你徛佇路邊 舉懸懸
這遍我總算 停落來

[Verse]
伊講 手指頭 瘦去
袂牢 才會落佇路
新的 早就買好矣
舊的 我猶原欲愛

[Bridge]
沙塵 吹過 補胎店
一圈一圈 輪攏袂停

[Chorus]
我替你 戴轉去彼隻手
一路騎 免閣揣
我徛佇路邊 看你
騎去 前面彼个紅燈

[Outro]
胎補好矣 氣打飽矣
戒指轉去 伊的手

tracks.title: ตีสี่กับหุ่นโชว์
tracks.genre: Thai Congolese soukous (rumba-derived guitar dance song)
tracks.subject: At 4 a.m. before a Siam department store opens, window dresser Noi pins a sequinned lime-green dress onto a stubborn mannequin, ends up swaying her around the display to fix the fit, and the manager walks in early.
tracks.caption: Thai Congolese soukous, rumba-derived dance groove with a Thai party feel. Two interlocking clean electric guitars (one rolling arpeggios, one bright high sebene riff), punchy round electric bass, congas and a tight drum kit with a driving hi-hat, short unison horn stabs. Bright live-studio recording, dry and punchy, hand claps, no reverb wash. Male lead, warm light baritone in full chest voice, clearly sung, with a few friends answering in the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Playful, flirty, swaying dance-floor swagger. No rap, no autotune, no synths, no accordion, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bright sebene guitar riff, congas, horn stab]
[Verse 1]
ตีสี่ห้างยังมืด
น้อยถือกล่องเข็มหมุด
ชุดเลื่อมเขียวมะนาว
ใหญ่ไปสองนิ้วเต็มๆ
[Pre-Chorus]
แขนหุ่นไม่ยอมงอ
น้อยจับหมุนไปมา
[Chorus]
เต้นกับหุ่นโชว์ ตีสี่ก่อนห้างเปิด
เข็มเต็มปาก เท้าย่ำตามจังหวะ
หมุนซ้ายหมุนขวา เลื่อมวับที่เอว
ไม่มีใครเห็น มีแต่ยามหน้าประตู
[Verse 2]
ยามชะโงกมาถาม พี่ทำอะไรครับ
น้อยตอบหน้าตาย วัดตัวให้เข้าชุด
เสียงรองเท้าดังมา
ผู้จัดการมาเช้า
[Pre-Chorus]
ผู้จัดการยืนนิ่ง
น้อยหยุดหมุนทันที
[Chorus]
เต้นกับหุ่นโชว์ ตีสี่ก่อนห้างเปิด
เข็มเต็มปาก เท้าน้อยหยุดกลางเพลง
ผู้จัดการยิ้ม บอกชุดนี้เข้ากันดี
ขอเต้นด้วยคน ก่อนลูกค้ามา
[Bridge - sebene guitar solo, hand claps]
ชุดเรียบร้อย เข็มสุดท้ายเสียบเสร็จ
หุ่นสาวยืนนิ่ง ไม่รู้ว่าใครเต้น
[Chorus]
เต้นกับหุ่นโชว์ ตีสี่ก่อนห้างเปิด
เข็มเต็มปาก ทั้งสามคนย่ำเท้า
หมุนซ้ายหมุนขวา เลื่อมวับที่เอว
ลูกค้าคนแรกมา มองตู้ไม่วางตา
[Outro - guitars and congas fade, one last horn stab]

tracks.subject: Seven-year-old Prae throws her fallen upper tooth under her grandmother's stilt house, as custom says, then crawls under with her father's torch and finds a marble, an earring and grandpa's whistle but no tooth, while the hen eyes her.

Crisp 1960s-style studio sound, small room reverb, guitars panned wide. Female lead, bright clear soprano-alto in full chest voice, clearly sung, doubled lightly in the chorus. tracks.title: สี่นาทีของลุงสม
tracks.genre: Thai ranat ek and string quartet chamber pop
tracks.subject: Uncle Som, keeper of a provincial clock tower in Phrae, climbs sixty-one steps each Sunday to wind it and sets it four minutes fast on purpose so the rushing townsfolk arrive on time, and he hides the key when the district office orders it corrected.
tracks.caption: Thai ranat ek and string quartet chamber pop, slow lyrical Thai-classical meets Western strings. Ranat ek wooden xylophone playing rolling arpeggios, cello holding a low drone, two violins in slow harmony, light frame drum on the downbeats. Close intimate chamber-room recording, natural wood resonance, soft hall air. Male lead, mature warm baritone in full chest voice, clearly sung, plain and unhurried. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D major. Gentle, wry, quietly stubborn. No rap, no autotune, no drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no pop-ballad piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - ranat ek arpeggio, cello drone]
[Verse 1]
ทุกวันอาทิตย์ ลุงสมขึ้นหอนาฬิกา
หกสิบเอ็ดขั้น มือถือกุญแจเก่า
ไขลานครบสามรอบ ฟังเสียงเฟืองหายใจ
เลื่อนเข็มไปข้างหน้า เร็วไปสี่นาที
[Pre-Chorus]
ช่างจากกรุงเทพบอกว่าเดินผิด
ลุงยิ้มแล้วชงชาให้
[Chorus]
ให้มันเร็วสี่นาที ไม่เห็นเป็นไรเลย
เด็กหญิงเห็นเข็มชี้เก้า รีบวิ่งเข้าโรงเรียน
แม่ค้ารีบไปตลาด ยังทันซื้อปลาสด
ในเมืองนี้ไม่มีใครสาย เพราะลุงแอบให้เวลา
[Verse 2]
นายอำเภอบอกว่าต้องแก้
ให้ตรงเวลาหลวง
ลุงซ่อนกุญแจไว้ในกระป๋องชา
ระฆังตีเก้า ก่อนเก้าโมงสี่นาที
[Pre-Chorus]
นายอำเภอขึ้นมานั่งหอบ
ลุงยื่นชาให้แก้วหนึ่ง
[Chorus]
ให้มันเร็วสี่นาที ท่านลองดูก่อนไหม
เมื่อเช้าท่านมาประชุม ทันก่อนเวลาเสียอีก
แม่ค้ารีบไปตลาด ยังทันซื้อปลาสด
ในเมืองนี้ไม่มีใครสาย เพราะลุงแอบให้เวลา
[Bridge - strings alone, ranat sparse]
เวลาจริงลุงให้ใครไม่ได้
แต่สี่นาทีเล็กๆ ให้ได้ทุกวัน
[Chorus]
ให้มันเร็วสี่นาที ลุงไม่แก้ให้ใคร
นายอำเภอพยักหน้า ยกแก้วชาแทนคำตอบ
เด็กหญิงเห็นเข็มชี้เก้า รีบวิ่งเข้าโรงเรียน
ในเมืองนี้ไม่มีใครสาย เพราะลุงแอบให้เวลา
[Outro - ranat ek single notes, cello drone fades]

tracks.title: ทอนเจ็ดสิบห้า
tracks.genre: Thai 1960s Italian canzone pop (Sanremo-style strings and mandolin)
tracks.subject: Mon, a toll-booth attendant at lane three of a Bangkok expressway, has three seconds a day with the woman in the white car who always pays exact coins; the day she hands him a 100-baht note, he counts the 75 baht change slowly while she smiles and horns sound behind.
tracks.caption: Thai 1960s Italian canzone pop, Sanremo-festival style sung in Thai. Felt-hammer grand piano, string section of violins and cello with warm legato lines, mandolin tremolo in the gaps, soft acoustic bass, brushed drum kit with a gentle backbeat. Warm 1960s Roman studio recording, natural room reverb, gentle tape saturation. Male lead, smooth warm tenor in full chest voice, clearly sung, easy and unforced, with a light male-female backing duo in the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, D major. Warm, easy, quietly hopeful. No rap, no autotune, no synths, no electric guitar, no trap drums, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano chords, mandolin tremolo, soft strings]
[Verse 1]
ช่องสามทางด่วน หมวกเอียงทุกเช้า
เจ็ดโมงสิบห้า รถขาวคันนั้นมา
เธอยื่นเหรียญสามเหรียญ จากกระเป๋าใบเล็ก
ยี่สิบห้าบาทพอดี ไม่เคยต้องทอน
[Pre-Chorus]
ผมมีเวลาแค่สามวินาที
พูดได้คำเดียว ขับดีๆ นะครับ
[Chorus]
เมื่อเช้าเธอยื่นแบงก์ร้อย ผมทอนช้าๆ
เจ็ดสิบห้าบาท ทีละเหรียญ นิ้วเธออยู่ใกล้
แตรข้างหลังดังลั่น ผมไม่รีบสักนิด

tracks.genre: Thai choir-led gospel-soul with piano and hand claps
tracks.subject: A first-time father pacing outside a delivery room counts 143 ceiling tiles, clutching tiny socks he bought in May, until the nurse leaves the door ajar and he hears the first cry and sits down on the floor.
tracks.caption: Thai gospel-soul, slow 6/8 choir-led gospel sound sung in Thai. Grand piano playing block gospel chords, a large mixed gospel choir in full harmony leading the answers, round electric bass, brushed drum kit in a slow shuffle, hand claps on the backbeat in the chorus. Warm live-church-hall recording, natural room reverb, analog warmth. Male lead, rich mid-high tenor in full chest voice, clearly sung, rising to a full-voiced chorus with the choir answering. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, F major. Grateful, swelling, shaky with relief. No rap, no autotune, no organ, no synths, no EDM drops, no trap drums, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano chords, soft drums, choir hum]
[Verse 1]
ห้องรอคลอดชั้นสาม ผมเดินวนเป็นรอบที่ร้อย
นับแผ่นฝ้าเพดานได้ร้อยสี่สิบสาม
มือล้วงกระเป๋า หยิบถุงเท้าเล็กๆ
ที่ซื้อเก็บไว้ตั้งแต่ต้นปี
[Pre-Chorus]
พยาบาลเปิดประตูแง้ม
ผมได้ยินเสียงแรก
[Chorus]
เสียงนั้นเล็กนิดเดียว แต่ดังกว่าทั้งตึก
ขาผมอ่อนจนต้องนั่ง ลงกับพื้นหน้าห้อง
ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ ที่เธอมาถึง
ผมไม่รู้จะพูดอะไร ได้แต่ขอบคุณ
[Verse 2]
ผมเคยกลัวว่าจะเป็นพ่อไม่เป็น
เคยฝึกอุ้มข้าวสารถุงละสามกิโล
พยาบาลยิ้มบอกว่าเข้ามาได้
มือผมสั่นเหมือนจับของที่แตกง่าย
[Pre-Chorus]
เธอหลับตาอยู่บนเตียง
แต่ยิ้มให้ผมก่อน
[Chorus]
เสียงนั้นเล็กนิดเดียว แต่ดังกว่าทั้งตึก
ผมคุกเข่าข้างเตียง ถือถุงเท้าสองข้าง
ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ ที่เธอมาถึง
ผมไม่รู้จะพูดอะไร ได้แต่ขอบคุณ

ร้อยสี่สิบสามแผ่น ผมจำได้ทุกแผ่น
แต่เสียงเดียวนี้ ผมจะจำไปทั้งชีวิต
[Chorus]
เสียงนั้นเล็กนิดเดียว แต่ดังกว่าทั้งตึก
ผมสวมถุงเท้าให้ เท้าเล็กกว่านิ้วโป้ง
ขอบคุณ ขอบคุณ ที่เธอมาถึง
ผมไม่รู้จะพูดอะไร ได้แต่ขอบคุณ
[Outro - piano chord, choir hum, fade]

tracks.title: Cuộn Len Thứ Mười Một
tracks.subject: A shy young man in a Đà Lạt wool shop is asked to hold a skein of yarn across both hands while a girl winds it into a ball; twenty minutes of facing her undoes him, so he buys a skein every Saturday, owns eleven, cannot knit, and finally lets her teach him the first stitch.
tracks.caption: Yacht rock, smooth Californian-style soft rock sung in Vietnamese. Rhodes electric piano with soft bell-toned chords, clean chorus-tone electric guitar with light funk strums, fretless bass with round gliding lines, alto saxophone countermelody, drum kit with brushed hi-hat in a relaxed backbeat. Polished late-70s studio sheen, warm analog compression, gentle plate reverb. Male warm light tenor, smooth mid register, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, E-flat major. Bashful, warm, quietly smitten. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no falsetto.

Tiệm len Đà Lạt chiều thứ Bảy

tracks.subject: Chú Lực, a strict ticket inspector on Hà Nội's Cát Linh metro, finds a six-year-old boy riding every morning with a ticket drawn in crayon; he stamps it as valid day after day, until the station chief comes down to inspect and Chú Lực has to defend a drawing.
tracks.caption: Cape Verdean funaná dance music sung in Vietnamese. Button accordion with fast reeling riffs, ferrinho iron scraper with steady scraped sixteenth-note drive, cavaquinho with bright strummed chords, electric bass with bouncing root-fifth groove, drum kit with driving kick and snare. Live dance-hall sound, accordion and scraper up front, dry and punchy. Male bright baritone, playful full voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 144 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, bouncy, soft-hearted. No rapping, no autotune, no synthesizers, no distorted guitar, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion, iron scraper]

[Verse 1]
Chú Lực soát vé ga Cát Linh
Mắt chú tinh như mắt diều hâu
Có thằng nhóc sáu tuổi bước lên
Giơ tấm vé vẽ bằng sáp màu

[Pre-Chorus]
Vé không có mã
Vé có con tàu

[Chorus]
Vé đỏ vé xanh vé tô sáp màu
Chú Lực đóng dấu, hợp lệ nhé
Tàu điện chạy qua mái nhà
Vé của bé tí, chú đóng mỗi ngày

[Verse 2]
Tuần sau nó vẽ thêm cái cổng
Có cả chú Lực, có mũ, có còi
Sáng nay ông trưởng ga xuống kiểm tra
Hỏi: chú Lực, vé này của ai

[Pre-Chorus]
Chú nói: vé tháng đặc biệt

[Chorus]
Vé tím vé vàng vé tô sáp màu
Ông trưởng ga gãi đầu, gật gù
Chú Lực đóng dấu, hợp lệ nhé
Vé của bé tí, ai dám bắt đâu

[Bridge - accordion solo, cavaquinho]
Mẹ nó cười ở đầu toa kia
Chú dán tấm vé lên tủ phòng trực

[Chorus]
Vé đỏ vé xanh vé tô sáp màu
Chú Lực đóng dấu, mẹ nó cười
Tàu điện chạy qua mái nhà
Vé của bé tí, chú đóng mỗi ngày

[Outro - accordion, iron scraper]
Hợp lệ nhé, hợp lệ nhé

tracks.title: Cuốn Sổ Ba Mươi Mốt Tên
tracks.subject: Bà Sáu, godmother to thirty-one children of her Biên Hòa parish, has never missed one godchild's birthday, each logged in a school notebook; on her own eightieth birthday, an ordinary Sunday after mass, she has forgotten it, and all thirty-one godchildren are waiting at the church gate with a brass band and presents.
tracks.caption: Vietnamese heartland rock with a street-anthem build. Rolling piano driving eighth-note chords, tenor saxophone playing punchy riffs and a mid-song solo, Telecaster with bright chiming strums and twangy fills, bass guitar on steady roots, drum kit with a big cracking snare on beats 2 and 4. Live-in-the-room band sound, big gated snare, warm tape saturation, wide chorus. Male warm baritone-tenor, full chest voice, anthemic delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, G major. Jubilant and big-hearted. No rapping, no autotune, no synthesizers, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no reggae offbeat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rolling piano, Telecaster]

[Verse 1]
Bà Sáu có cuốn sổ bìa xanh
Ba mươi mốt tên con đỡ đầu
Mồng ba tháng Tư là bé Na
Hai mươi tháng Chín là thằng Tâm

[Pre-Chorus]
Năm nào quà cũng đến sớm

[Chorus]

Chủ nhật tan lễ, bà chống gậy ra

tracks.genre: Vietnamese ru con-style folk lullaby ballad
tracks.subject: A café owner writes her chalkboard menu every dawn and keeps putting the wrong tone mark on words, 'sửa' for 'sữa'; each morning a stranger quietly rubs out the wrong mark with his thumb and fixes it, so she starts making the mistakes on purpose, until one morning the board is corrected and signed.
tracks.caption: Vietnamese ru con-style acoustic folk lullaby ballad in a slow six-beat sway. Nylon-string guitar with slow fingerpicked arpeggios, đàn tranh zither with soft plucked runs and glissandos, cello with sustained low countermelody, soft frame drum with a light heartbeat pulse. Intimate acoustic mix, close wooden resonance, light room reverb. Female warm clear alto, gentle but full voice, long-breathed melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 66 BPM, D major. Tender, gently amused, patient. No rapping, no autotune, no drum kit, no synths, no electric guitar, no trap hi-hats.

tracks.title: 最後一題
tracks.subject: A Wednesday-night host of a small local TV quiz in a Tseung Kwan O studio flips over the final-round card and finds it blank, so he asks the first thing in his head, whether the contestant has eaten yet, and a 70-year-old grandmother buzzes first and wins the restaurant voucher.
tracks.caption: Cantonese 1970s TV-variety brass pop, game-show strut. Big-band horn section with trumpets and trombones playing punchy stabs, walking electric bass, drum kit with tight snare and hi-hat, clean rhythm guitar chops, Hammond-style organ filling the gaps. live-in-the-studio 1970s television-orchestra sound, warm tape saturation, dry punchy drums. male baritone, bright and friendly, full chest voice, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, F major. Flustered, cheeky, warm bounce. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no synth pads, no slow ballad sections.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜三晚 將軍澳攝影棚
我着住西裝 袖口有啲窄
三位參賽者 手按住個鐘
冠軍有張 酒樓禮券

[Pre-Chorus]
最後一題 我翻開張咭
白紙一張 乜都冇

[Chorus]
問你一句 你食咗飯未
鏡頭對住我 我失晒聲
全場靜晒 等我出題
我只好問 你食咗飯未

[Verse]
導演企喺鏡頭後面 打手勢
燈光好熱 汗流入頸
我清清喉嚨 擠個笑容
揸住個咪 開口問

[Pre-Chorus]
阿婆一手按落個鐘
佢話 未呀 你呢

[Chorus]
問你一句 你食咗飯未
阿婆搶先按鐘 大聲答未
全場拍手 以為係神題
我都呆咗 你食咗飯未

[Verse]
導演搖頭 又點頭
我嘅汗 流過領呔
阿婆攞起張券 笑住講
後生仔 你都要食飯

[Bridge]
兩位後生 輸咗都拍手
攝影師笑到 鏡頭都震
我偷偷摸下 個肚

[Chorus]
問你一句 你食咗飯未
下個禮拜 我要搵新題
下個禮拜 咭上要有字
但係我都想問 你食咗飯未

[Outro]
多謝收睇 我哋下星期見
記得食飯 先好睇電視

tracks.title: 吹哨輝叔
tracks.subject: A 68-year-old retired storeroom clerk, Uncle Fai, gets new dentures that whistle on every four and every ten he says, so his wife can hear him coming from two streets away and finally catches him sneaking barbecue pork buns.
tracks.caption: Cantonese Bhangra-pop, bouncing dhol groove. Dhol playing the driving bhangra pattern with sharp open strokes, tumbi plucked riff, acoustic guitar strumming on the offbeat, fretless bass, dholki and hand claps. warm live-room recording, dhol forward and punchy, dry crisp percussion. male tenor, bright and cheeky, full chest voice, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G minor. Teasing, bouncy, affectionate dance groove. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no synth pads, no slow ballad sections.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
輝叔六十八 新裝咗副假牙
一講個四字 就吹起哨嚟
一講個十字 又吹多一下
成條街都聽到 佢嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
阿嬸喺廚房 聽到哨音
即刻放低鑊鏟

[Chorus]
嘟 嘟 嘟 輝叔嚟喇
講到四字 嘟嘟嘟
阿嬸一聽 就知道
你又偷食 叉燒包

[Verse]
想偷偷哋 買個包
行入茶餐廳 先講一聲
老闆話 四蚊一個呀
哨聲一響 全舖都笑

[Pre-Chorus]
佢掩住個口 退後兩步
個哨 偏偏更加響

[Chorus]
嘟 嘟 嘟 輝叔嚟喇
講到十字 嘟嘟嘟
阿嬸喺轉角 等住你
咬咗一啖 又畀你捉

[Verse]
佢喺屋企練習 慢慢講
四十四 又四十
個哨似水煲 滾晒
隻貓都嚇到 跳上櫃

[Bridge]
阿嬸忍唔住 笑到彎腰
話我鍾意 聽你吹

[Chorus]
嘟 嘟 嘟 輝叔嚟喇
講到愛字 嘟都唔響
阿嬸攬住佢 笑住話
包留低 我分你一半

[Outro]
四個包 你兩個 我兩個
嘟 嘟 輝叔 食飯喇

tracks.title: 畢業冊後頁
tracks.subject: A man pulls out his 1999 school yearbook after twenty-five years, finds a pencilled phone number on the back page that says call me after the exams, and dials it; the voice that answers says she had been wondering when he would look.
tracks.caption: Cantonese 1950s shidaiqu-style ballroom jazz, slow sway. Muted trumpet with a vocal-like line, upright bass walking slowly, brushed snare, jazz guitar playing sparse chords, vibraphone and a soft string pad. vintage Shanghai-Hong Kong ballroom studio sound, warm tube mic, light plate reverb. female alto, mellow and smooth, full chest voice, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, Eb major. Tender, wistful, warm sway. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no electronic synths, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
舊櫃桶底 一本畢業冊
九九年嘅 班房相
後頁用鉛筆 寫咗一行字
廿五年後 我先睇到

[Pre-Chorus]
個電話號碼 擦到好淡
考完試 打畀我

[Chorus]
我撥通電話 嘟嘟響兩聲
舊號碼 仲響緊
你拎起聽筒 輕輕笑
話我等你 打嚟

[Verse]
相入面 我企喺後排
頭髮好長 領呔歪咗
你喺第二行 轉頭望
唔知望緊邊個

[Pre-Chorus]
原來你嗰日 望住我
一直都冇行開

[Chorus]
我撥通電話 嘟嘟響兩聲
舊號碼 仲響緊
你拎起聽筒 輕輕笑
話我等你 打嚟

[Verse]
你話屋企電話 冇換過
媽媽講 總有人會打
我握住聽筒 手有啲震
鉛筆字 原來係你

[Bridge]
明晚七點 喺舊校門
帶住本冊 同一支筆

[Chorus]
我撥通電話 嘟嘟響兩聲
聽到你 一聲喂
兩個人各自 笑咗好耐
話考完試 終於打嚟

[Outro]
後頁嘅字 寫咗好耐
今晚 我先寫完

tracks.title: 一隻玻璃碟
tracks.subject: A woman finally returns a glass casserole dish with her friend's name on masking tape on the bottom, borrowed nineteen years ago when soup was brought after her baby was born, and stands holding it outside her friend's old door.
tracks.caption: Cantonese slowcore indie ballad, very slow sparse pulse. Clean electric guitar with slow tremolo, felt-muted upright piano, upright bass, brushed snare and soft kick, one sustained cello line. Sparse dry room recording, lo-fi tape warmth, wide silence between phrases. Female alto, plain and steady, low-mid register, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 70 BPM, D minor. Hushed, wistful, grateful and quietly hopeful. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no synth pads, no distorted guitar, no orchestral swell.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
廚房櫃頂 有隻玻璃碟
底部貼住 一條膠紙
上面寫住 阿玲兩個字
十九年前 佢拎過嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
我啱啱生完仔 手軟腳軟
佢煲咗一鍋湯 送嚟

[Chorus]
我拎住隻碟 行上去
撳門鐘之前 先深呼吸
唔知你仲住唔住喺度
我只想講 一聲多謝

[Verse]
後來你搬咗屋 我又冇空
訊息愈嚟愈少 愈嚟愈靜
每次諗起 都想打畀你
又話 遲啲先講

[Pre-Chorus]
碟邊有道裂痕
都係我當年 整嘅

[Chorus]
我拎住隻碟 行上去
撳門鐘之前 先深呼吸
唔知你仲住唔住喺度
我只想講 一聲多謝

[Verse]
隔離門打開 一個阿姨
話 阿玲而家搬咗落去
一樓舊舖頭 開咗間店
佢仲煲湯 賣畀人

[Bridge]
我行落樓梯 一步一步
聞到 湯嘅味

[Chorus]
我拎住隻碟 行入嚟
你抬頭望我 呆咗一陣
話你終於 拎返嚟喇
嚟 坐低 飲碗湯先

[Outro]
碟底嗰兩個字 貼咗好耐
今晚 我哋再煲湯

tracks.title: 掌紋接上了
tracks.subject: a young woman who reads palms at a night-market folding table, a trade her grandfather taught her, and the man who sits down, asks no question about money or exams, and whose palm lines meet hers exactly when they touch
tracks.caption: Mandarin Brazilian choro, nimble Rio roda-de-choro in lively 2/4 with a Chinese night-market setting. Cavaquinho playing bright rhythmic chord strums, 7-string guitar walking baixaria bass runs between the phrases, silver flute carrying the melody with quick turns, pandeiro with crisp jingle and thumb strokes. Warm intimate roda-de-choro live mix with natural room air. Female lead, warm low-mid chest voice, relaxed and clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, A minor. warm, teasing, nimble mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no electronic drums, no heavy backbeat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - flute, cavaquinho, 7-string guitar, pandeiro]

[Verse 1]
夜市最角落 一張小摺桌
我替人看手相 一次一百
生命線太短 我說會變長
感情線打結 我說放輕鬆

[Pre-Chorus]
今晚有個男生 坐下沒開口
伸出左手 掌心有點汗

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
看了這麼多年 別人的線
第一次 看見我自己

[Verse 2]
他說不問財運 也不問考試
只想問一件事 能不能牽手
我把手放上去 兩條線碰頭
爺爺教的口訣 全忘光了

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
看了這麼多年 別人的線
這一次 輪到你看我

[Bridge - 7-string guitar and pandeiro alone]
爺爺說 看相的人
不可以替自己算
那你替我算 我替你算

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
收攤吧 明天還在這裡
我們一起 看別人的線

[Outro - flute and cavaquinho fade]
今天的手相 不收錢

tracks.title: 磨到剩一片柳葉
tracks.subject: a hotel kitchen apprentice who inherits the retired chef's thirty-year-old cleaver, worn narrow as a willow leaf, resists changing its shape on the whetstone, and finds the handle already dented to fit his thumb
tracks.caption: Mandarin Nordic folk with nyckelharpa, slow 6/8 Swedish-Finnish forest-village folk ballad. Nyckelharpa playing a slow droning melody, fiddle in close harmony, kantele plucked in steady 6/8 arpeggios, soft frame drum pulse, double bass holding long root notes. Dry close-miked wooden-room acoustic recording with natural air. Male lead, warm baritone, steady and plain, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 88 BPM, D minor. patient, tender, quietly proud mood. No rap, no drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no pop ballad strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nyckelharpa, kantele arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
師傅留下一把菜刀
刀背黑黑 刀身窄窄
三十年磨成 一片柳葉
我接過來 不敢用力

[Pre-Chorus]
石頭先泡水 泡到不冒泡
一百下 我數出聲

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是他的手勢

[Verse 2]
今天頭一回 切番茄給他看
刀一落下 紅片薄得透光
師傅不說話 只把圍裙拉直

[Pre-Chorus]
水槽邊 一滴水掉在石頭上
我停了手 他也沒催

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是我的力氣

[Bridge - kantele alone, frame drum soft]
刀柄上凹了一小塊
剛好放得下 我的拇指

[Chorus]
來回 來回 一百下
刀要薄 手要穩
我磨掉的 是他的鋼
留下來的 是我們的刀

[Outro - nyckelharpa, fade]
磨好了 放回原來的位置

tracks.title: 黃旗搖搖過馬路
tracks.subject: a retired volunteer crossing guard at a Tainan primary-school corner waving his big yellow flag at 7:20 each morning, and the day he is five minutes late and the children stop the traffic with his flag themselves
tracks.caption: Mandarin 1970s glam rock stomp, singalong boogie with a Taiwanese school-corner setting. Crunchy overdriven electric guitar playing a chunky boogie riff in open A chords, stomping live drums with a heavy kick-and-snare backbeat, round driving bass guitar, tambourine and group handclaps on the chorus. 1970s glam-rock studio recording, big roomy drums, dry crunchy guitar, warm tape saturation. Male lead, bright warm tenor, cheerful and clearly sung with a strong melody, gang of friends and children chanting the chorus in unison. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, A major. bright, bustling, affectionate mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth bass, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - boogie guitar riff, stomping drums, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
七點二十分 路口黃旗揮
我是老陳 退休三年了
小學生一隊 過馬路排排走
我的旗子 比老師還大

[Pre-Chorus]
左邊來車 停一停
右邊機車 慢一慢

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 跟我走
紅燈變綠 我不趕你們
小腳小腳 踩斑馬

[Verse 2]
有個小女孩 每天數我揮幾下
她說昨天十二下 今天十五下
我說老人家 手臂在跳舞

[Pre-Chorus]
今早我感冒 遲到了五分鐘
路口那邊 怎麼這麼靜

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 自己走
小女孩舉著我的旗
公車停下來 乖乖等

[Bridge - guitar and bass only, drums drop out]
我站在遠遠的巷口
手裡拿著藥 眼睛濕濕

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 一起走
老陳也排進隊伍
小腳小腳 帶我過

[Outro - boogie riff, stomps and handclaps fade]
明天七點二十 我準時

tracks.title: 水桶裡找洞
tracks.subject: a bicycle-shop mender who dunks inner tubes in a water bucket to find the leak by its bubbles, and the young man who comes back every afternoon at 4:30 with a tyre that has no puncture at all, on a bike he rents by the hour just to stand by her bucket
tracks.caption: Mandarin British music-hall singalong, brisk 2/4 pub stomp with a Taiwanese bicycle-shop setting. Upright piano pounding oom-pah left hand with bright right-hand fills, banjo-ukulele strumming a brisk 2/4 chop, plucked double bass on the beat, stomping boots and a rattling washboard. Dry crowded pub-stage mix, lively and slightly rough. Female lead, bright mid voice with a cheeky character delivery, clearly sung, a few friends shouting the chorus back in unison. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, C major. playful, cheeky, brisk mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM synths, no drum kit, no heavy distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano, banjo-ukulele, stomping boots]

[Verse 1]
每天下午四點半
他牽著腳踏車 到我車行
前輪軟軟的 他說沒氣了
我說 先放進水桶

[Pre-Chorus]
內胎壓進水裡 冒一串泡
哪裡漏氣 哪裡就唱歌

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡冒泡
哪個洞 哪個洞
輪胎沒破 氣門蓋鬆了
他的車胎 比他還會演

[Verse 2]
第二天 第三天 同一條胎
我貼上膠片 壓三下
他說好了嗎 我說早好了

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡不冒泡
沒有洞 沒有洞
輪胎沒破 是人慌了
我的水桶 他站最久

[Bridge - piano and stomping boots only]
他終於說 這輛車是租的
每天租一個鐘頭
就為了 來我桶邊站

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡冒泡
這回有洞 這回有洞
我這顆心 沒人會補
咕嚕咕嚕 你來試試

[Outro - piano and banjo-ukulele, big stop]
明天四點半 換我帶水桶
